notes:
The paper gives a nonsignificant narrative result for MC/NoMC perceived readability, but prints no test statistic or exact/bounded p for that test. Nulls retained. Original title and DOI verified in accepted manuscript. Replication full text could not be obtained via the publisher DOI route, Unpaywall, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, and targeted open-access searches; no statistics or replication verdict inferred from an abstract.
Source follow-up: Published conference article, pp.35–52. Rendered primary PDF pages 9,11,12 checked, including exact ANOVA digits. Requested page locator used to select ANOVA treatment statistic. Distinct Mack-Skillings MS = 0.0786, p = 0.777 on PDF p.9. Authors Table 27 explicitly marks findings equal Y.
